DESCRIPTION.Common Locations.model_specs_readme_path: Required. Path to the model specifications help document.
DESCRIPTION.Routers: Required non-empty dictionary of router entries keyed by user-defined names. Any entry can be selected as a migration source or destination. All declared path fields except password and device_key are required strings.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>: Per-router paths. Supports ~; relative paths resolve from the working directory. Credential requirements come from the selected model specification, not the presence of configuration fields.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.specs: Required router model specification JSON. It contains exactly router_specs and config_fields. router_specs holds identity, shared codec settings, optional encode additions and optional edit settings. Unused properties and empty sections are omitted. Wrapper/checksum/trailer settings are shared because decode validates what encode writes. HG659 uses codec.encryption_settings, codec.signature and encode.private_exponent_hex; protected-field settings are in edit.field_encryption. config_fields is an expandable name/path list; the configuration path belongs in edit.configuration_file. One ROUTER_FUNCTIONS dictionary maps methods directly to portable functions. The loader receives both specification and schema paths. Existing decode/view/edit/encode and combined actions remain available, including migration in TestingTools and file-driven details in AutomationTools. UltraHub cryptographic processing remains unestablished, and local round trips do not prove physical-router restore acceptance.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.password: Optional password-file path for the reference template. If omitted and password_required is true, TestingTools prompts interactively. When password_required is false the password is unused. Migration source passwords are prompted separately.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.template: Required. Path to this router model's reference encrypted backup. When selected as a migration destination, this template provides the base configuration.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.template_decoded: Required. Decoded .tar.gz archive of this router's reference template.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.template_decoded_d: Required. Directory containing the extracted reference template.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.template_edited: Required. Rebuilt .tar.gz archive for TAR/GZIP models, or preserved edited .xml for signed single-file configurations.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.template_edited_di: Required. Directory containing the edited reference template.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.template_encoded: Required. Encrypted backup output from template editing and encoding.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.original: Required. Path to this physical router's backup. Used when this router is selected as the migration source, with its actual router password.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.migration_decoded: Required. Decoded .tar.gz archive or single-file .xml from this router's physical backup when selected as the migration source.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.migration_decoded_: Required. Directory containing the extracted physical source backup.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.migration_edited: Required. Reserved output path for an edited source .tar.gz archive or single-file .xml configuration.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.migration_edited_d: Required. Directory containing the edited source configuration settings to transfer to the selected destination.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.migration_converte: Required. Decoded .tar.gz archive or single-file .xml destination configuration, initially prepared from this router's template and rebuilt during encoding.
Required. Directory containing the prepared destination template with the converted source settings applied.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.migration_encoded: Required. Encrypted backup generated when this router is selected as the migration destination, using the destination router password supplied during encoding.
DESCRIPTION.Routers.<router name>.device_key: Optional binary device-unique credential-file path used only by device-key derivation, such as Ultra Hub. A missing or empty key is rejected when that mechanism is selected; THENC derivation and authentication remain unavailable. HG659 fixed-key AES reads firmware parameters from its model specification and does not use this field.
